problem.title: Dynamic Connectivity Queries
problem.problemStatement: You are given N vertices and Q online operations. Each operation is one of the following: • Add an edge between two vertices. • Determine whether two specified vertices are currently connected. Process all queries efficiently.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and Q. • Next Q lines describe the operations.
problem.output: For every connectivity query, print YES or NO.
